name: Marybel Micaela Lorenzo
office: Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Marybel Micaela Lorenzo is a real estate agent running for the Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District board. She states she earned a bachelor's degree in sociology from Cal State San Bernardino and spent more than 12 years at Grameen America, helping underserved women entrepreneurs. Her campaign says she wants to bring transparency, accountability, and family engagement to the school board.
